notes.title: Happy Late New Year and some announcement about Roseverte's works.
notes.content:
Happy Late New Year and Happy Early Lunar New Year!

I apologize for not updating more often. To put it shortly, last year Roseverte works are full with learning unity and some other works which is not ready to be announced yet at this moment.
Still, I got some news about the current progress to share.

[h1]How to Take Off Your Mask PV is being aired inside Animate Japan[/h1]
So, the game will have a browser game type version on Animate Games (Japanese version only), which is different with the current mobile version. It's a more simplified version than the current one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018656/ed5caa36715a9e1817a29e286c652919019cfccc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Moving to Unity[/h1]
Those who have followed me on Twitter might already know this but I'm learning unity now and I plan to use it on my future works. Sadly it doesn't go as smooth as I thought it would be, as it's quite different than my former engine, and a lot of feature needs to be customized to match my needs.
The reason of this changes is, beside the former engine is not getting updated to match the newest OS, unity has more potential to widen the platform where I can release the game. There will be more issue to settle though.

Although I can't reveal yet all new features, I still have some stuffs that I can announce. They will be implemented in Roseverte future products.

[list]
[*] Blinking eyes and mouth movements
The new engine enable mouth movements and blinking eyes, though the file size might be bigger than the current one.
[*]Animated UI
User Interface like the in game menu and others will be different from the current one and a simple animation will be added to it.
[*]Screen Size will be 1280x720
Some people might have noticed but the current Roseverte Game is still using 1136x960 resolution. The future games will have bigger file size than the current one.
[/list]

I will also try to implement the joypad control better for PC but I can't guarantee this yet as I meet a lot of issue regarding to the game controller now.

That's all and happy playing :D

User Interface like the in game menu and others will be different from the current one and a simple animation will be added to it.
Screen Size will be 1280x720

notes.title: Urgent announcement about Mac OSx Catalina Update
notes.content:
Today I got an email which mentioned that people who has played the game with the non notarized version got a trouble to play the notarized version, so I decided to reverted all the apps which I has updated to support Catalina to the previous version while I'll try to find out the solution. 

Only East Tower series are still at 32 bit which won't work with Catalina, so I will build a non notarized 64 bit version first to settle the issue first.
I already tested but the non notarized 64 bit version apps are still working fine with Catalina, so that should be fine for the temporary solution.

Beside this, I also noticed the earlier build of CAFE 0 Mermaid achievements are not triggered on Mac. This will also get my priority too. Hopefully I can update everything until tomorrow.
I'm very sorry for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
Chu-3/Roseverte

notes.title: How to Sing to Open Your Heart - Dev Blog 4
notes.content:
Hi.
Happy New Year everyone!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018656/bf1f53e15600f895eaec5d8a78d33efec16e4846.jpg[/img]

The release is getting closer and I will report about the recent progress of the game :3
There are some changes I decided and some bugs fixing that I need to finish in past few weeks, therefore I apology for the lateness of the update.

[h1]ːreginaːCurrent Progressːreginaː[/h1]
All finished beside things below:
English Version Beta Testing: 50% 
Japanese Version Beta Confirmation (Bugs have been fixed, but need one more time final confirmation)
Voice: 93% (stuff to retake only)

[h1]ːjuliːWhat Will Be Changedːjuliː[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b][i]In-game singing movie will be removed.[/i][/b]
[/list]
This is formerly something I planned to add if the crowdfunding was successful. Sadly, it was failed. I was thinking to push myself to keep the in-game additional movie (Myana singing scene like in the previous game), but it takes more workload than what I've imagined. Based on the beta test result, there is nothing weird even if there's no in-game singing movie. Therefore I decided to go on without it.
[i][b][list]
[*] In-game term: Research institute chief > Research institute director.
[/list][/b][/i]Some people told me that "chief" is usually only used within military related institute. That's why the term "chief" here will be changed by "director". I believe you might have seen the same word too at the previous games, and they will be fixed as well later.
[b][i][list]
[*] Button sound will only be played when you click the button.
[/list][/i][/b]I have already tried to fix the annoying button sounds at HTFALK, but I still got a feedback that it's still bothering when the mouse pointer accidentally hovers a button. Now you will only hear the sound when you click the button.
[list]
[*] [i][b]"Continue to the next chapter?" message now will only appear for a moment then automatically forward you to the next chapter.[/b][/i]
[/list]
The message now will not ask you to choose, but after showing the current stat, it will forward to the next chapters automatically and won't bother your auto mode.

[h1]ːliliaːNew Demoːliliaː[/h1]
So, as the result of the beta test, there will be a slight change in the demo, like the line breaks, and some new term. A new demo will be ready in a few days. Although, there will be no difference in the story. Just a slight change to make the flows better. Also, extras menu will be updated with locked images or music that will be unlocked later in the full version.

[h1]ːkingjuliːA Week and Few Days Before the Releaseːkingjuliː[/h1]
[b]Are you ready?[/b]
To be honest I'm very nervous at this moment. 
There is no major bug as far, and I hope it would be smooth until the release ><
It still takes a while, but I'll do my best!
And last...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018656/bf1f53e15600f895eaec5d8a78d33efec16e4846.jpg[/img]
Wait... what is this place? 😗😗😗
Be sure to find more about it within the game~❤

notes.title: How to Sing to Open Your Heart - Dev Blog 1
notes.content:
Hi. It's been a while since the last update, and I decide to write the development blog of "How to Sing to Open Your Heart (Kokouta)" here, to inform you more about the upcoming game.

[h1]ːleeaːAbout Main Game Releaseːleeaː[/h1]
First, I'm very sorry that I couldn't release the game within this year, as what I previously planned. The new release date would be 2019 January 17th. 

[h1]ːliliaːAbout Demo Releaseːliliaː[/h1]
I'm doing my best in polishing the demo now, and if there's no further issue happened, the demo should be release at November 15th, which means within this month! At this moment, only the opening movie left to finish the demo.

[h1]ːjuliːCurrent Progressːjuliː[/h1]
Scenario (Japanese & English) : 100%
Art: All beside the CGs and some cut scenes.
Movie: OP Movie 80% Additional in-game movie 0%
Voices: 90% (All finished beside stuff to retakes)
Programming: 42%
Theme Song: 100%

[h1]ːreginaːNew Costumesːreginaː[/h1]
There will be several new costumes for the characters.
Myana will get 2 additional costumes, while Lilia and Lio one.
Other characters might also get additional costume later depends on the situation they are.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018656/93ed4ef7e8c651d73ac883eff3b1bda5a4a37313.png[/img]

notes.title: How to Take Off Your Mask major update v2.0!
notes.content:
I have updated How to Take Off Your Mask games on Steam for English, German, and Japanese version. The update for the demo will follow soon.
This updates shouldn't affect your save data.

You should get these updates automatically.

[h1][b]The Changes[/b][/h1]
[b]1. Button’s Sound Effect[/b]

Many people told me that HTTOYM Button sounds is very loud and bothering, which I assume happened because of the high frequency of the sound. This has been fixed in HTFALK, and the same changes will be applied to HTTOYM.

[b]2. GUI[/b]

HTTOYM GUI will be updated with HTFALK GUI design, and make the quick save/load features enabled.

[i]The GUI until now:[/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/9ae7527d12dd349312100dbb65e36f3174b9dd36.jpg[/img]
[i]The new GUI:[/i]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/e22f29f5b1c06ba5ef44fbe0bc99dfce388677b6.jpg[/img]

Beside the Menu button at the bottom part of the text box, you can also access the menu using the right click button.

[b]ATTENTION:[/b] This fix will be applied automatically if you start a new game, but you won’t see this gui fix immediately if you’re using an old save data. To use this fix with an old save data, please finish a chapter, choose to not continue the story, return back to the Title Screen (Don’t simple return to the chapter selection, since this fix is applied inside the title screen’s code), then go to start and choose the next chapter you’re going to continue with (without using the load menu).

[b]3. New Shortcut Keys[/b]

You can now also use the A key for Auto Forward, P for Skip (old: only Ctrl for force skipping all text, and skip button inside menu), and Esc for Menu.

[b]4. Right click menu is now enabled during the choice.[/b]

In the old version, enabling a right click menu during the choices will cause bigger issue, but somehow I found a workaround to solve this. Now you can access the menu easily by using right click (old version is menu button only) and also you can choose to use quick save to save the game easier.

Thank you for keep supporting the project :)

notes.title: Spanish version is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Spanish[/b] version of "How to Take Off Your Mask" is now available on Steam.
Thank you  to [b]José Sierra[/b] for the translating help!ːleeaːːliliaː
The translation is based on the [b]Latin America Spanish[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/f0a28e070d06c74f422878214e7aa827baed1aea.jpg[/img]

If you're more comfortable with English and want to switch languages, please remember you can switch it from the game's property on Steam.

How to change the language:
1. Right click the title from your steam library, choose properties.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/38a9a1c763fe4a47017d9a8c81d73c8bdc0b96e7.jpg[/img]

2. Go to language tab and choose the language you want.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9234571/3f5a9d181b38ccd7531f34f6dc83bba8379899a4.png[/img]

The game will download several additional datas before you can play with the language you want. Remember that the save data can't be used in other language version.
